Creates a new cloud migration session in Grafana that initializes the process for migrating a Grafana instance or its resources to Grafana Cloud. Retrieves details of a specific cloud migration session in Grafana using its unique identifier (uid). This GET endpoint allows administrators to check the status and configuration of an ongoing or completed migration session, including information about what data is being or has been migrated to the cloud. Deletes a specific cloud migration session identified by its unique identifier (uid) in Grafana. This operation removes all data associated with the migration session, including configuration details, progress tracking information, and any temporary migration artifacts. Once deleted, the migration session cannot be recovered and any in-progress migration activities associated with this session will be terminated.
